step1_analysis.description: A sub-circuit of a pipelined ADC, likely an NMOS switch network with dummy transistors (XM3, XM4, XM7) used for charge injection cancellation in a switched-capacitor MDAC or integrator.

paper_reference.title: A 15-b 40-MS/s CMOS Pipelined Analog-to-Digital Converter With Digital Background Calibration

sky130_expected.calculation: System level metric, depends on thermal noise (kT/C) and quantization noise.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Assuming similar capacitor sizing (4pF) and oversampling/calibration, SNDR should be comparable.
Depends heavily on the digital background calibration effectiveness.

Power_Consumption.description: Total power consumption of the ADC

sky130_expected.reasoning: SKY130 at 1.8V might consume less power than 0.25um at 2.5V, but depends on the specific architecture.

Opamp_Gain.description: DC gain of the operational amplifiers in the pipeline stages

sky130_expected.reasoning: Achieving 90dB in SKY130 typically requires a two-stage or gain-boosted folded cascode topology.

Switch_ON_Resistance.description: ON resistance of the NMOS switches in the extracted sub-circuit

sky130_expected.reasoning: With W/L = 5u/0.5u and Vgs=1.8V, Ron is roughly 1 / (270u * 10 * (1.8 - 0.42)) ~= 270 ohms.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC operating point, transient response, and switch ON-resistance of the NMOS network.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for NMOS Switch Network
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u

XM1 N4 LABEL_NET_0 N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N3 LABEL_NET_1 N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N3 LABEL_NET_2 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N3 LABEL_NET_3 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 LABEL_NET_4 LABEL_NET_5 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N5 LABEL_NET_6 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N3 LABEL_NET_7 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N2 LABEL_NET_8 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N0 LABEL_NET_9 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}

VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_3 LABEL_NET_3 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_4 LABEL_NET_4 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_5 LABEL_NET_5 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_6 LABEL_NET_6 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_7 LABEL_NET_7 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_8 LABEL_NET_8 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_9 LABEL_NET_9 0 1.8

VN0 N0 0 1.8
VN1 N1 0 0
VN4 N4 0 1.8
VN5 N5 0 0

.control
op
let v_n2 = v(N2)
let i_n0 = -i(VN0)
let r_on_xm9 = (v(N0) - v(N2)) / i_n0
print v_n2 i_n0 r_on_xm9

tran 1n 1u
meas tran v_n2_avg avg v(N2)
let power = i_n0 * 1.8
print power
quit
.endc
